set.body:
Outcome: give each feature column an explicit scientific definition shared across drawing, contour, batch, and prediction workflows.

Scope: a compact feature_spec API and validation/serialization contract, extending the immediate guard. Cover ordered properties, exact bin edges and boundary rules, dimensional units, weights, normalization denominators, estimator IDs and definition versions, curvature smoothing scales, branch windows/exponents/reference radii, junction tolerances, AOF/raster/mapping settings, and missingness/coverage rules. Distinguish tangent-angle units from degrees of visual angle. Require a finite positive pixels-per-degree calibration when physical visual-angle units are requested; never guess it. Keep semantic compatibility separate from input hashes, canvas sizes, timestamps, and extraction provenance. Record tracing method, threshold, thinning, simplification tolerance, and provider/version when applicable.

Policy: mlv2023 remains default for one release, with explicit implementation/definition versions including documented port deviations. turning and arclength are opt-in methods; arclength is the main new curvature method. Existing parity defaults and numerical fixtures stay stable. Do not promise a later default switch. Define how legacy descriptors upgrade without inventing unavailable training information.

Acceptance:
- Validate malformed, missing, and conflicting fields; round-trip specifications without changing meaning.
- A field-level compatibility report distinguishes true semantic mismatch from harmless input provenance differences.
- Equivalent drawings at different pixel calibrations can resolve to the same physical feature specification; absent calibration fails when required.
- Enumerate all public measurement settings in a contract table and document each default, unit, and version.
- Fix supported-feature scope for Release A; avoid an unrestricted plugin/configuration framework.
set.title: Define versioned feature specifications, calibration, and estimator policy
